guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「以熱量、料床停留與排放證據理解爐排燃燒控制」為主軸，依序處理垃圾熱值與負荷邊界、爐排速度與物料停留、煙氣污染質量通量、整合煙氣處理績效、毛發電與淨效益。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Understand grate combustion through heat input, bed residence and emission evidence, progressing through Waste heating value and load boundary, Grate motion and material residence, Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Gross generation and net benefit. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 LHV 改成 6 MJ/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4.44444 變成 3.33333 MW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 λ 改成 1.6，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4827.59 變成 5517.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 v 改成 0.12 m/min，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變成 50 min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 ΔT 改成 50 K，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將量測 O₂ 改成 12%，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45.4545 變成 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Ef 改成 220 kWh/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 950 變成 890 kWh/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only LHV to 6 MJ/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4.44444 to 3.33333 MW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only λ to 1.6, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4827.59 to 5517.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only v to 0.12 m/min, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 60 to 50 min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only ΔT to 50 K, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only measured O₂ to 12%, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 45.4545 to 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Ef to 220 kWh/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 950 to 890 kWh/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」，依代表性分樣求含水與熱值，和料重、蒸汽負荷及未燃分交叉檢查。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「一次與二次空氣的功能」，同時比對氧氣、一氧化碳與溫度；分辨整體缺氧和局部混合不足。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「爐排速度與物料停留」，以標記粒子或數位重播比較前緣與尾端到達時間，記錄速度分布。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「含水進料的熱需求」，在同一時段讀取流量與上下游溫度，加入散熱項後檢查能量殘差。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「煙氣污染質量通量」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「氧校正與比較基準」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「整合煙氣處理績效」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「風量阻力與引風」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「毛發電與淨效益」，用分表與主表核對電量和，避免把外部用戶用電算作設備損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「異常事件重播與可用率」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Waste heating value and load boundary, Use representative samples for moisture and heating value, cross-checking feed mass, steam load and unburned residue. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Primary and secondary air roles, Compare oxygen, carbon monoxide and temperature together to separate global oxygen shortage from local poor mixing. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Grate motion and material residence, Use marked particles or digital replay to compare leading and trailing arrival times and record speed spread. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Heating demand of wet feed, Record flow and upstream/downstream temperatures over one interval; include losses and check the energy residual. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Flue-gas pollutant mass rate, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Oxygen normalization and comparison, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Integrated flue-gas treatment performance, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Draft and gas-path resistance, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Gross generation and net benefit, Reconcile submeters with the main meter and avoid charging external users to equipment losses. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Upset replay and availability, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 只控制質量流率而忽略含水與熱值，會造成熱負荷波動。 在「垃圾熱值與負荷邊界」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
總氧量足夠但配風不均，仍可能產生局部未燃區。 在「一次與二次空氣的功能」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
用機構速度代替物料速度，可能低估回混與滯留。 在「爐排速度與物料停留」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
忽略水分蒸發會把熱量全部誤算為升溫。 在「含水進料的熱需求」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「煙氣污染質量通量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「氧校正與比較基準」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「整合煙氣處理績效」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「風量阻力與引風」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只報毛發電會掩蓋高阻力、低效率輔機的影響。 在「毛發電與淨效益」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「異常事件重播與可用率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Mass-flow control alone misses heat-load changes caused by moisture and heating value. Mark where this error can enter the Waste heating value and load boundary flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Sufficient total oxygen with poor distribution can still leave locally unburned zones. Mark where this error can enter the Primary and secondary air roles flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Using mechanism speed as material speed can miss back-mixing and hold-up. Mark where this error can enter the Grate motion and material residence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Ignoring evaporation incorrectly assigns all heat to temperature rise. Mark where this error can enter the Heating demand of wet feed flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Flue-gas pollutant mass rate flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Oxygen normalization and comparison flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Integrated flue-gas treatment performance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Draft and gas-path resistance flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Reporting gross generation hides energy penalties from high-resistance, inefficient auxiliaries. Mark where this error can enter the Gross generation and net benefit flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Upset replay and availability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
